basics.name: Jussi Peltonen
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer, Partner
basics.summary:
Jussi is a senior software engineer with extensive skills in designing, creating and maintaining mobile and backend software solutions.

Jussi has a wide experience from different IT technologies ranging from safety-critical embedded devices to modern mobile technologies and backend applications. He also has skills and experience in working with Linux, DevOps and cloud applications. If the project needs tools unfamiliar to Jussi, he can learn them in a fast pace.

The recent advances in AI offer exciting opportunities in automating IT work and processes.
basics.x-tagline: Most problems have several good solutions, yet none of them suits every case – a professional is someone who can choose the one that fits the situation at hand.

projects.name: Consumer mobile banking and loyalty application
projects.description: Android and backend development for the retail bank's mobile banking and loyalty app. The consumer application is a banking and loyalty application used actively by a large user base in Finnish, Swedish, and English languages, and has high reliability, availability and accessibility requirements.

projects.name: Desktop automation application for medical professionals
projects.description: The client's product is a Windows & macOS desktop application for automating the repetitive tasks for medical professionals. In this role Jussi took part in selecting the used technologies, designing, and implementing the desktop application and setting up the CI pipeline.

projects.name: Field technician mobile app
projects.description: A field technician mobile app for the client's technicians. It is used to manage the daily schedules for fleet maintenance, provide step-by step instructions for maintenance tasks, manage spare part orders, and more. Jussi worked as a member of the Android developer team.
projects.x-note: The technology list in the source is identical to the pharmaceutical wholesale highlight project and does not match the Android work described; possibly copy-pasted, kept as in the source.

projects.name: Embedded analysis device application support layer
projects.entity: Global corporation focused in the business areas of diagnostics, life science research
projects.description: In this position Jussi worked in a team responsible for writing the application support layer in an embedded analysis device. During this project, Jussi developed, tested and documented Linux middleware components to interface the device's hardware components and assisted application developers with using these components from application code.
projects.x-note: The source title has no role; the role was taken from the other assignments of the same employer.

projects.name: Linux server security product
projects.description: Jussi was part of the team responsible for the Linux server security product that detects, prevents, and reports security threats by using a variety of different heuristics. The work involved e.g. writing code to monitor system calls made by running applications, to detect abnormal network connections, etc.
keywords: Linux service development with C++ & Go

projects.name: Consumer mobile application
projects.description: The client's consumer mobile application is used by its consumer clients. Jussi was part of the team designing the phone application. Work consisted of specifying, implementing, and testing the Flutter application. Jussi also did some work with the application's backend.

projects.name: Microservice refactoring for a healthcare digital service platform
projects.description: The client's digital service platform is a modern platform where pharmacies, hospitals, health stores, pharmaceutical and health product companies, and other healthcare operators can connect in a new way. Jussi's task was to refactor deprecated microservices from the Lagom framework into a system powered by Spring Boot and the Axon framework.
projects.x-note: Appears only on the Project highlights slide, where the same entry is repeated four times; output once. Not listed under All client projects; placed here by date.

projects.name: Smart waste monitoring app
projects.description: A smart waste monitoring solution: a remote monitoring app for the client's smart devices. Jussi was responsible for the Android development, using Kotlin programming language.

projects.name: Stove guard monitoring app
projects.description: Jussi designed and implemented the Android version of the client's app, a monitoring application for the client's stove guard devices. This project involved creating various custom UI components and debugging Bluetooth LE stack issues on various mobile devices.

projects.name: Area reservation tool backend
projects.description: In this project Jussi was a member of the team responsible for implementing the backend for a permit management system (area reservation tool). The backend combines data from various sources, e.g., a GIS database, an ERP system for finances, and a reservation database.

projects.name: Thermostat data analysis demo
projects.description: FIWARE tools for the client, Cloud-based data analysis tool demo for the client's thermostat data

projects.name: IP Router software development
projects.description: IP Router software development in C language

projects.name: Senior software engineering

projects.name: Mobile application and platform middleware development
projects.description: Windows Phone application development using C# and C++. Lead developer for a mobile imaging app. UI work with C#, algorithm optimizations with C++. Middleware development for a mobile Linux platform. Lead developer in the platform's input methods team. Took part in the design and implementation of the platform's Input Methods Framework. Helped team members with implementation issues. Co-operated with inhouse and external partners’ SW teams. Occasionally acted as the team’s scrum master.

projects.name: DRM library porting to a mobile Linux platform
projects.description: Familiarized with a mobile Linux platform. Porting a Windows-based DRM library to the platform. Interfacing to GStreamer media framework.

projects.name: X-ray analyzer software team management
projects.description: Managing a team of software developers. Coordinating in-house and subcontractor software work. SW project resourcing and scheduling. Developing software for an X-ray analyzer.

projects.name: Handheld X-ray analyzer embedded Linux and controller application
projects.description: Setting up an embedded Linux system and cross-compilation tools for handheld X-ray analyzer. Developing controller application for the analyzer.

projects.name: Embedded energy consumption research
projects.description: Studying the energy consumption of an embedded microcontroller. Investigating options for implementing an energy-optimizing C compiler. Design and implementation of automatic measurement tool for statistical analysis of assembly instruction-level power consumption. C++ lectures. Leading a project for reference implementation of remote media control protocol.

projects.name: Remote media control protocol and embedded tools
projects.description: Designing a protocol for remote media control. Teaching C++ and object-oriented programming. Software development and tool design for embedded systems.
